column1: # Reviewed allowlist of the nuclei pack (D-528 step 2, lead decision after step-2 review r1, 2026-11-14): every template that runs
# without the disruptive tick (the KEV set of the LAN scan and the own-IP checks, and the deep set) is listed here, read by a person
# and found to change nothing on the target and reach no other host. One a line: id<TAB>sha256 of the file read<TAB>why. A file that
# changed (another sha256) stops `make scan-pack` until it is read again. Candidates: docs/research/kev-review-queue.md ("read first"
# group first). Reviewers: say who and when in the reason.

column3: Drupal: the register form's AJAX callback renders passthru of cat /etc/passwd; name is missing so the form fails and no account is made (D-528 author and review kev r1 L-2, 2026-11-14)
Webmin backdoor: password_change.cgi for user rootxx, which does not exist, runs cat /etc/passwd through old; no password changes (D-528 author and review kev r1 L-2, 2026-11-14)
OFBiz: forgotPassword/../ProgramExport throws an exception carrying the output of id and ipconfig; nothing is reset or stored (D-528 author and review kev r1 L-2, 2026-11-14)
OFBiz: the same ProgramExport check with the Groovy in \u escapes, decoded by review kev r1: id and ipconfig only; nothing stored (D-528 author and review kev r1 L-2, 2026-11-14)
